email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Digital Marketing Specialist role at your Benelux importer of commercial vehicles. With hands-on experience in SEO, GEO, content and web management, I am excited by the opportunity to grow three brands across the Benelux.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I build and optimize websites for both traditional and AI-powered search, manage CMS content, and use analytics to track performance. I have implemented structured data, llms.txt and GEO initiatives to improve visibility in generative search engines. My technical background allows me to work effectively with tools like Google Analytics, Google Ads and WordPress, and I enjoy turning ideas into concrete marketing actions.

I am drawn to your focus on B2B lead generation and brand consistency across markets. I am fluent in English, have working knowledge of Dutch, and am eager to contribute to a team that values initiative and commercial results.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can support your marketing goals.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Junior Digital Marketing Specialist position at your Benelux importer of commercial vehicles. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO and GEO, and a technical background in web development, I am eager to contribute to the growth of your three brands across the Benelux.

In my current roles as a freelance SEO specialist and junior digital marketer, I have gained hands-on experience in planning and executing digital marketing initiatives. I have built and optimized websites for both traditional and AI-powered search engines, implemented structured data and llms.txt files, and used tools like Google Analytics, Google Ads and Semrush to track and improve performance. My work on client sites, including e-commerce and association platforms, has taught me to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a focus on results.

What attracts me to this role is the opportunity to work at the intersection of brand visibility, lead generation and B2B customer engagement. I understand the importance of consistent brand positioning and localizing campaigns for different markets. My technical skills allow me to collaborate effectively with international teams and external partners, and I am comfortable adapting to new tools and platforms. I am fluent in English, have a working knowledge of Dutch, and am motivated to learn more about the automotive sector.

I am a proactive and solution-oriented marketer who enjoys turning ideas into concrete actions. I thrive in environments where I can take ownership and contribute to commercial growth. I am excited about the prospect of supporting your sales teams with marketing initiatives that build awareness and generate qualified leads.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• SEO & GEO expertise: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical audits, structured data, and AI search visibility (llms.txt, entity optimization).
• Hands-on digital marketing experience: managing SEO content, CMS (WordPress, Shopify), and email marketing for client websites.
• Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads to track and optimize campaign performance.
• B2B and commercial focus: supported digital workplace sites for major retailers and logistics firms, and built lead-generation flows.
• Multilingual: fluent English, native Turkish, Dutch (B1 writing, A2+ speaking); eager to apply in Benelux markets.
